positions.title: Lying down
positions.text: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the soles of your feet on the floor. The muscle is easiest to feel in this position.

positions.title: Sitting
positions.text: Sit upright on a chair, feet on the floor, knees slightly apart. Don't lean back; keep your shoulders relaxed.

positions.title: Standing
positions.text: Feet shoulder-width apart, knees not locked. Spread your weight evenly over both feet.

positions.title: In everyday life
positions.text: When walking, climbing stairs or standing up: squeeze just before you move.
